A.prompt: Dark cinematic graphic-novel illustration, wide 16:9 composition with the subject on the left third and a large empty dark area on the right side, high contrast, sharp hard-edged shadows, flat vector shapes with soft painterly gradients and clean linework. All human figures are solid pitch-black silhouettes with a completely smooth, plain head shape — no nose bridge, no lips, no chin line, no jawline, no ear, no facial contour of any kind, just a flat unbroken silhouette edge even in profile or rim light. Dramatic camera angle, moody atmosphere. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image. Palette: pure black shadows with electric red, electric blue and amber neon rim lights. Scene: a woman silhouette with a ponytail standing in a dark room, a thick glowing red thread loosely wrapped around both wrists and stretching out of frame to the right, strong electric red rim light, pure black background. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, photorealistic, photograph, detailed faces, facial features, face profile, nose, lips, mouth, chin outline, jawline, ears, facial contour lines, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, low contrast, cheerful bright colors, 3d render.
